Data.purpose: Shell commun nLab pour navigation persistante, préférences d’interface, vues multiples, sections pliables et fenêtres flottantes.

theme.svg_rule: Use currentColor so inline/themeable SVG follows semantic CSS tokens without duplicating image files.

rules: Temporary pages must use the final application shell rather than a visually separate placeholder layout.
Application shell owns interaction grammar, never project business labels or data.
Projects configure available options but must preserve a direct home/navigation recovery path.
UI preferences are convenience state only and never an authorization boundary.
Themeable SVG uses currentColor or semantic CSS variables rather than maintaining color-specific asset copies.
Floating windows compose COMP_FLOATING_WINDOW; drag/resize/lock mechanics must not be redefined project by project.
View identity is semantic and comes from NLAB_VIEW_VARIANTS.
Production bundles may inline the runtime to reduce external requests while preserving this component as the canonical source.
Page sharing QR belongs inside contextual help by default to avoid persistent visual clutter.
Stable UI IDs are part of the interaction contract and support precise contextual help and development requests.
Footer sharing may expose a stable semantic URL while contextual help may expose the exact versioned context.

homogeneity.rule: All pages inside one application, including temporary/placeholder pages, use the same application shell, semantic tokens, header grammar, preference model, floating-window mechanics and responsive behavior.
homogeneity.variable_surface: Only central business/content modules vary by page.

security: Never encode credentials, session tokens, GitHub tokens or other secrets.
Prefer a canonical share URL supplied by the application runtime over iframe/internal browser URLs.
Authentication remains enforced by the destination application.

desktop.behavior: free floating windows; full shell controls; multi-column views

tablet.behavior: clamped windows; wrapped shell controls; same functional surface

mobile.behavior: bottom-sheet floating windows; touch targets >= 42px; single-column content; horizontal control overflow allowed

rules: Responsive behavior changes layout, not business capability.
Mobile/tablet must use the same semantic UI IDs and help bindings as desktop.
Floating drag/resize may be disabled on narrow touch viewports when the panel becomes a bottom sheet.

target_policy.nested_surface: stable semantic root without explicit version when a CURRENT resolver exists

footer_share.mobile_use_case: transfer the current application/cockpit to phone, tablet or another display without retyping a long URL

dictionnaire_donnees.note: Shell d’application commun pour cockpit, studio et dashboards nLab.
